title: Laredo Public Health Thanks Family Caregivers During National Family Caregivers Month
excerpt: Laredo Public Health is recognizing family caregivers this November, National Family Caregivers Month. Its Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Program offers support and resources for caregivers at (956) 795-4957.
content:
November is National Family Caregivers Month, and Laredo Public Health is taking a moment to thank the people who care for loved ones every day.

The department's Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Program is recognizing caregivers for the time, love and compassion they give to those they look after. Caregiving can be both challenging and meaningful, and the program says caregivers' patience, strength and dedication make a lasting difference.

Caregivers looking for support or resources can reach the Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Program at (956) 795-4957.

Sources: Laredo Public Health, Nov. 25, 2026.
